column1: # agents-prices.tsv — your prices for `agents report`'s API-equivalent cost.
# API list prices ship with agents (prices.tsv beside its modules, as of the
# date in its header, replaced on every update), so you need this file only
# to change one of them or to price a model they do not list. Copy it to
# ~/.config/tuidev/agents-prices.tsv (or point AGENTS_PRICES in
# ~/.config/agents.conf at another path), then add a line per model from the
# vendors' own pages:
#   Anthropic: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing
#   OpenAI:    https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing
# Format: one model per line, tab- or space-separated, # starts a comment:
#   MODEL_PREFIX  IN  CACHE_WRITE_5M  CACHE_WRITE_1H  CACHE_READ  OUT
# each price in US dollars per million tokens: input, cache writes cached for
# five minutes and for an hour (OpenAI has one cache-write price: write it
# twice), cache reads and output. A line of the older form,
#   MODEL_PREFIX  IN  CACHE_WRITE  CACHE_READ  OUT
# prices both kinds of cache write at CACHE_WRITE. Your lines are read after
# the shipped ones: a prefix listed in both takes yours. A model takes the
# longest prefix that names it up to a version boundary: the prefix itself,
# or followed by a date (-20251001), a version tag (-v1, :0), [1m] or @...,
# after routing prefixes such as us.anthropic. or openai/ are dropped. A
# prefix ending in - or . names a family (my-model- prices my-model-2 and
# my-model-3 alike). A malformed line is reported and ignored.
# The cost is what the same tokens would cost on the API: on a subscription
# plan you pay the plan, not this. AGENTS_PRICES=off shows no cost at all.
# Examples: a negotiated price for one model, and a local model family that
# costs nothing per token.
#   my-local-model-     0     0      0      0      0
